title: List disks and partitions in Arch live environment
summary: Identify the block devices (disks) available for installation using fdisk or lsblk.
prerequisites: Booted into Arch Linux live environment

steps.explain: List all block devices and their partitions. Ignore devices ending in rom, loop, or airootfs.
steps.expect: List of disks like /dev/sda, /dev/nvme0n1 with their partitions.
